description: Dagger of Veiled Shadows Level 60 Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Spiked Hilt - Vermillion Idol x 2 - Gold Scarab x 5 - Clay Scarab x 5 - Cenarion Circle:
name: Dagger of Veiled Shadows
